ipa.financial_contracts.fx_option.Definition

Available as lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts.fx_option.Definition.

Syntax

Definition(
    *,
    asian_definition: FxAverageInfo = None,
    barrier_definition: FxBarrierDefinition = None,
    binary_definition: FxBinaryDefinition = None,
    buy_sell: BuySell | str = None,
    call_put: CallPut | str = None,
    instrument_tag: str | None = None,
    exercise_style: ExerciseStyle | str = None,
    end_date: str | None = None,
    double_barrier_definition: FxDoubleBarrierDefinition | None = None,
    double_binary_definition: FxDoubleBinaryDefinition = None,
    delivery_date: str | None = None,
    notional_amount: float | None = None,
    notional_ccy: str | None = None,
    settlement_ccy: str | None = None,
    settlement_type: SettlementType | str = None,
    forward_start_definition: FxForwardStart | None = None,
    dual_currency_definition: FxDualCurrencyDefinition | None = None,
    payments: InputFlow | None = None,
    start_date: OptDateTime = None,
    strike: float | None = None,
    tenor: str | None = None,
    underlying_definition: FxUnderlyingDefinition = None,
    fields: OptStrStrs = None,
    pricing_parameters: PricingParameters | None = None,
    extended_params: ExtendedParams = None,
)

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
asian_definition FxAverageInfo No None Fixing details for asian options
barrier_definition FxBarrierDefinition No None Details for barrier option.
binary_definition FxBinaryDefinition No None Details for binary option.
buy_sell BuySell | str No None The side of the deal.
call_put CallPut | str No None Tells if the option is a call or a put.
instrument_tag str | None No None User defined string to identify the instrument.It can be used to link output results to the instrument definition. Only alphabetic, numeric and '- _.#=@' characters are supported. Optional.
exercise_style ExerciseStyle | str No None EURO or AMER
end_date str | None No None Expiry date of the option
double_barrier_definition FxDoubleBarrierDefinition | None No None Details for double barriers option.
double_binary_definition FxDoubleBinaryDefinition No None Details for double binary option.
delivery_date str | None No None Expiry date of the option
notional_amount float | None No None The notional amount of currency If the option is a EURGBP Call option, amount of EUR or GBP of the contract
notional_ccy str | None No None Currency of the notional amount If the option is a EURGBP Call option, notional_ccy can be expressed in EUR OR GBP
settlement_ccy str | None No None
settlement_type SettlementType | str No None
forward_start_definition FxForwardStart | None No None Details for Forward Start option.
dual_currency_definition FxDualCurrencyDefinition | None No None Details for dual currency option.
payments InputFlow | None No None
start_date OptDateTime No None
strike float | None No None strike of the option
tenor str | None No None tenor of the option
underlying_definition FxUnderlyingDefinition No None Details of the underlying. Can be used to override some data of the underlying.
fields OptStrStrs No None Contains the list of Analytics that the quantitative analytic service will compute.
pricing_parameters PricingParameters | None No None The pricing parameters to apply to this instrument. Optional. If pricing parameters are not provided at this level parameters defined globally at the request level are used. If no pricing parameters are provided globally default values apply.
extended_params ExtendedParams No None If necessary other parameters

get_stream

Returns a streaming quantitative analytic service subscription

get_stream(session: Session | None = None) -> Stream

Parameters

Parameter Type Required Default Description
session Session | None No None Means the default session will be used

Returns

Stream

Raises

Exception When
AttributeError If user didn't set default session.

Example

import lseg.data.content.ipa.financial_contracts as ldf
definition = ldf.fx_option.Definition(
   instrument_code="FCHI560000L1.p",
   fields=[
       "MarketValueInDealCcy",
       "DeltaPercent",
       "GammaPercent",
       "RhoPercent",
       "ThetaPercent",
       "VegaPercent",
       "ErrorCode",
       "ErrorMessage",
   ],
)
response = definition.get_data()

# Using get_stream

stream = definition.get_stream()
